# LokTube 2.0.0

- Open a separate incognito window from the header.
- Right-click videos, channels, albums or playlists and choose **Open in incognito**.
- Incognito starts signed out with an empty homepage: no recommendations or Shorts.
- Watch and search history are disabled; account cookies, libraries and normal tabs stay separate.
- Temporary browser storage is cleared when the private window closes. Incognito does not hide network activity from YouTube or your network provider.
